text:
My signup endpoint took 8 seconds because it sent the welcome email inline.

The fix wasn't a faster SMTP server — it was a queue.

Async processing basics every backend dev needs:

• Message queues vs pub/sub — point-to-point vs broadcast
• At-least-once delivery — retries mean duplicates; design for it
• Backpressure — slow consumers shouldn't OOM your producers
• When async is wrong — not everything belongs on a queue

Decoupling work changed how I think about "done" at the API layer.
